variants.name: Vòng rừng bên thác
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit target: current-runtime.png, redesign the entire forest environment into a richer explorable original Vietnamese xianxia forest. Supporting style reference: B-bright-handheld.png (master Bright Handheld pixel style, not a layout to copy). Output a single 16:9 landscape 1920x1080 scene mockup. Remove all existing HUD, text, labels, buttons and minimap; the real UI will be overlaid separately. No readable text, watermark, letters or numerals in the illustration.
Style: top-down 3/4 handheld-era crisp pixel art, deliberate hard pixel clusters, bright mint and leafy greens, cyan water, warm sand paths, gray blue mossy rocks, warm timber and old vermilion roof tiles. Consistent game camera, no perspective horizon, no smooth painterly or 3D look. Hero only 50–65px tall relative to 1920px width, buildings around 230–300px wide, main paths 100–140px wide. Forest feels rich but walkways and small monster clearings remain readable; avoid huge empty lawn. Preserve usable space at top-left for compact profile and bottom-left for minimap.
REQUIRED IN EVERY VARIANT: One small abandoned wooden cultivator cottage: 25–35% of tiled roof caved in, exposed broken beams, leaning porch post, broken wall, scattered roof tiles and vines, still recognizable as a house, not a giant dungeon or village. A clearly visible animated-looking white waterfall over a mossy rock ledge into cyan pool/stream. Many irregular natural clusters of tall bamboo AND rounded broadleaf trees, understory ferns, roots, fallen trunk, flowers, large moss boulders, medium stones and small pebble beds. A connected pale earth route with optional side clearings, a wooden directional sign beside east-edge exit to village; no portals.
Exactly FOUR DISTINCT ENEMY TYPES visible as separate identifiable creatures at gameplay scale, no clones: (1) small walking wooden root stump spirit with leaf shoots (level 1), (2) orange mushroom creature with cream stem body and round cap (level 1), (3) coiled emerald bamboo snake with segmented markings (level 1), (4) larger moss-backed stone creature with jade crest (level 2, about 1.5x others). Scatter level-1 creatures in accessible clearings, place stone creature in deeper waterfall area with optional approach; never block the only exit path. One blue-robed chibi human player on the main path.
Six sparse harvestable plant clumps: two slim emerald medicinal grasses and two small white dew flowers (level 1), one purple layered lingzhi fungus near deadwood and one cyan jade-leaf herb beside waterfall (level 2). Distinguish these from ordinary ferns by leaf silhouettes and very subtle few luminous pixels, no enormous glow columns or icons.
Keep existing game connection: east path returns to village, compact real HUD to be added afterward; do not draw an inventory, combat screen, quest panel or decorative frame. This is a concept mockup, not a production flattened map.
VARIANT COMPOSITION: A wide looping path circles a central clearing, waterfall upper-left feeding a small western pool, ruined cottage upper-right inset in bamboo, east entrance halfway down right. Footpath branches toward waterfall without requiring crossing water. Clear center suitable for moving and visible herb gathering, rich edge vegetation. Balanced readable overall exploration loop.
